sections.title: A useful fixed chunk
sections.content: attól függ ("it depends") is built from az ("that") in the -tól/-től form plus függ ("depends"), but it's easiest to just learn it as one chunk. Use it alone as a complete answer, or add hogy + a clause to say exactly what it depends on.

items.spanish: Kirándulunk a hétvégén? Attól függ, hogy milyen az idő.
items.english: Are we going hiking this weekend? It depends on what the weather's like.
Our plan depends on the weather.

sections.content: függ always pairs with -tól/-től for whatever the thing depends on: valamitől függ ("it depends on something"). Keep the two together in your memory as one pattern, not two separate words.
